title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0016e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.025898
  m_eff = 2.3471e-1 eV
  T_vev = 4.3974e-1 m⁻²
  ω = 0.3335 s⁻¹
  k = 0.2304 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.690823 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -1.088e-2
  J_spin = -7.765e-4
